{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the sales data with proper parsing of revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders, as per the dictionary: only completed orders count for conversion
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate conversion rate per customer_segment
conversion_rates = completed_orders.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Verify that we are not confounded by channel: check if customer_segment and channel are independent
channel_segment_crosstab = pd.crosstab(completed_orders['channel'], completed_orders['customer_segment'])

# Display the crosstab
channel_segment_crosstab"}
